math500.notes: 500 held-out math problems. Dataset revisions are resolved and recorded when downloading.

minerva.notes: Verify this hosted benchmark copy against the exact paper dataset before claiming reproduction.

olympiad.notes: English text-only open-ended competition math. The upstream evaluation questions are published under a split named train; this program performs inference only. The paper does not identify its exact subset. Multiple required answers are retained as a JSON list string.

college.notes: Accessible College Math benchmark mirror; exact identity with the paper split has not been established. Replace with the paper's original JSONL for strict reproduction.

amc23.notes: 40 questions; report avg@32, not majority-vote accuracy or pass@32.

aime25.notes: 30 questions; report avg@32, not majority-vote accuracy or pass@32.
